_meta.note: State-platform pass, MN-D (DFL): re-source national-only party-platform cells to the DFL Ongoing Platform (2024) where it names the question's policy (3 of 29 cell groups). public_justice q0 F->T on the plank backing strong law enforcement policies (same rule as IN-D, CO-D, MA-D).
